name: @pipeworx/mcp-cheapshark

tools.name: deals
tools.description: Search PC game deals across digital stores (Steam, GOG, Humble, etc.) filtered by store, price range, Metacritic score, Steam rating, title, or sale status; returns deal ID, sale price, normal price, savings %, and store.

sortBy.description: DealRating | Title | Savings | Price | Metacritic | Reviews | Release | Store | Recent. Already returns BEST-first for the field you pick (biggest Savings, highest Metacritic, cheapest Price) — you do NOT need `desc` to get the top results.

desc.description: Reverse the default best-first order — i.e. WORST first (smallest savings, lowest Metacritic, most expensive). Leave unset for top results; sending true is almost never what you want.

tools.name: games
tools.description: Look up a PC game by title (or steamAppID) across CheapShark's catalog; returns the game's cheapest current deal, cheapest historical price, and list of active deal IDs across stores.

tools.name: game
tools.description: Fetch full deal and price-history details for a single CheapShark game by its numeric game ID; returns all active store deals, cheapest price ever, and Steam rating info.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cheapshark forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cheapshark pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
